How Many People Fit in a Party Bus?

A party bus at Scottsdale Sprinters fits 28 people: the Party Bus (28 Pax) seats 28, and it is the only party bus we list. The party class runs 13 to 28 seats, from the Limo Party Sprinter (12-13 Pax) at 13 to that 28-seat bus. A group past 28 moves to a coach seating 24 to 56. Every number here is a seated count, with the published rate and minimum beside it.

Last updated: September 18, 2026

How many people fit in a party bus?

28. The Party Bus (28 Pax) is the party bus in the Scottsdale Sprinters fleet and its canonical seated capacity is 28, so 28 is the answer for that vehicle whatever the occasion. People asking the question usually mean the wider party class, and there the range is 13 to 28: the Limo Party Sprinter (12-13 Pax) at 13, the Ultra Luxury Party Sprinter at 15, the Limo Party Sprinter (16 Pax) at 16, the Pink Hummer Limo at 18 and the Party Bus (28 Pax) at 28. Those five are the celebration units — what a bachelorette, a birthday or a night out is offered — and their seat counts are what the booking system enforces. A group of 28 therefore has exactly one party-class option; a group of 13 has all five.

Party bus size and capacity, vehicle by vehicle

Each row below carries the seated capacity, the published hourly rate, that vehicle's minimum, the starting total before tax, and that total split across every seat. Nothing here is a per-seat ticket: you reserve the whole vehicle, so 20 riders and 28 riders pay the same for the same Party Bus (28 Pax). The current published hourly rates run $175–$295/hr in the party class and $185–$325/hr on the coaches, each on its own minimum — 4 hours on everything except the 56-Passenger Motorcoach, which holds 5. The fare is the rate times billable hours and never below that minimum, which is why the total column is a starting total, not a quote. Arizona sales tax of 8% is added at checkout and a 50% deposit confirms the vehicle. Availability varies by date, so check availability and request a current quote for your date, vehicle and trip details before you reserve.

How many people can fit on a bus bigger than a party bus?

24 to 56. Past 28 riders the vehicle stops being a party unit and becomes a coach: the Mini Bus (24 Pax) at 24, the Executive Mini Bus — Grech (27 Pax) at 27, the Executive Mini Coach (29 Pax) at 29 and the 56-Passenger Motorcoach at 56. That step is not arbitrary: 20 passengers is where our own refund engine reclassifies a booking as a large group. Every vehicle above the line is a proper-seat coach — forward-facing seating, an aisle, a chauffeur — rather than a lounge interior, so it carries more people for less per seat but not the same room. One naming note, because it trips people up: the Mini Bus (24 Pax) is named for its seats. The number inside its internal identifier is a retained legacy reference, and 24 is the capacity we sell and book. Above 56 riders the answer is more than one vehicle, not a bigger one. We run more than one of the Mini Bus (24 Pax), the Executive Mini Bus — Grech (27 Pax) and the Executive Mini Coach (29 Pax), and a self-serve request may ask for up to 3 of one of them — 87 seats across 3 of the Executive Mini Coach (29 Pax). A booking of 2 or more vehicles is a large group by the same rule.

How do you pick the right size?

Match the headcount to the smallest vehicle that seats it, then check the bags. Every capacity we publish is a seated count, and no standing or riding figure exists anywhere in our catalog, so a party bus that seats 28 carries 28. Round up rather than down, and count everyone who boards. The fare does not move with the headcount, so stepping up a size costs the difference in the hourly rate and nothing per head, while the per-seat column falls as the vehicle grows: a full 56-Passenger Motorcoach is about $29 a head at its minimum, against $54 on the Limo Party Sprinter (12-13 Pax).

What changes the count

Three things, and none of them is the vehicle's seat count moving. Luggage is the first: the bag caps we publish are Ultra Luxury Party Sprinter 6, Limo Party Sprinter (16 Pax) 30, Executive Mini Bus — Grech (27 Pax) 40, Party Bus (28 Pax) 45, Executive Mini Coach (29 Pax) 30, 56-Passenger Motorcoach 125. On the rest — the Limo Party Sprinter (12-13 Pax), the Pink Hummer Limo and the Mini Bus (24 Pax) — no verified bag count exists, so the fit is confirmed in writing with the reservations team instead of guessed at here. The second is whether the unit repeats. Every party-class vehicle is one of a kind, so two party buses is not something we can promise; the executive minis and coach are the units we run more than one of. The third is the minimum. Booking fewer hours than a vehicle's minimum does not lower the total — 56-Passenger Motorcoach bookings bill at least 5 hours, everything else at least 4 — so a short trip for a big group is priced by the floor.

Typical group sizes by occasion

Most enquiries land in three bands: 13–18 riders for a limo Sprinter or the Pink Hummer Limo, 28 for the Party Bus (28 Pax), and a coach at 24 to 56 seats beyond that. The occasion decides the interior; the headcount decides the size. Bachelorette parties, bachelor parties, birthdays and Scottsdale nightlife runs sit in the party class at 13 to 28 seats — a lounge interior for a group that stays together all night. Wedding transportation splits: the couple's vehicle is small, the guest shuttle is a coach running a loop. A group that has grown past the Party Bus (28 Pax) is where a coach wins on seats and on the per-seat split at once — $29 a head at full capacity on the 56-Passenger Motorcoach.

Does anyone on board not count toward the seats?

No. Your chauffeur is not one of the 28 — the published capacity is passenger seats, and the driver is separate — but every passenger counts, of any age. Age changes what is served, not how many fit: "Passengers 21 and over bring their own alcohol, and we do not sell it. Arizona vehicle-for-hire open-container policy, A.R.S. § 4-251, allows it, and if anyone under 21 rides, no alcohol comes on that trip." and "No underage drinking. Anyone under 21 stays on soft drinks." A rider under 21 takes a seat exactly like anyone else.

What the seat count costs

Take the starting total and divide it by the seats. At the minimum, that is $36 a head on a full Party Bus (28 Pax) ($1,000 before tax) and $29 on a full 56-Passenger Motorcoach ($1,625). Those splits assume every seat is filled: half a bus is twice the share. Per-person figures are an even split of the pre-tax fare, shown for planning only — the reservation is one vehicle, one total. To book: pick the vehicle and hours on the pricing page and confirm with the 50% deposit; the balance is charged to the card on file 48 hours before pickup. Or call or text (623) 986-6339, or email reservations@scottsdalesprinters.com, with your headcount.

Frequently asked questions

How many people does a party bus hold?

The Party Bus (28 Pax) at Scottsdale Sprinters holds 28 seated passengers. That is the canonical capacity the booking system uses, and the largest party-class vehicle we list.

How many people fit in a party bus?

28 fit in the Party Bus (28 Pax). Across the whole Scottsdale Sprinters party class the range is 13 to 28 seats: the Limo Party Sprinter (12-13 Pax) at 13, the Ultra Luxury Party Sprinter at 15, the Limo Party Sprinter (16 Pax) at 16, the Pink Hummer Limo at 18 and the Party Bus (28 Pax) at 28.

How many people can fit on a party bus?

28 — every one of them seated. Scottsdale Sprinters publishes seated capacity only; there is no standing count, so 28 is the working number for the Party Bus (28 Pax).

How many people can a party bus hold?

28 on our Party Bus (28 Pax), at $250 per hour on a 4-hour minimum. That is $1,000 before tax to start, about $36 a head with every seat filled.

How many people fit on a party bus?

28. If your group is larger, Scottsdale Sprinters moves you to a coach rather than a bigger bus — the Mini Bus (24 Pax) at 24, the Executive Mini Bus — Grech (27 Pax) at 27, the Executive Mini Coach (29 Pax) at 29 and the 56-Passenger Motorcoach at 56.

How many people can a party bus fit?

28 on the Party Bus (28 Pax), and 13 to 28 across the rest of the Scottsdale Sprinters party class. The smallest is the Limo Party Sprinter (12-13 Pax) at 13.

How many people does a party bus fit?

28 passengers, plus your chauffeur, who is not counted in the 28. Children and anyone under 21 occupy seats the same as any other rider.

How many people can fit on a bus?

On a coach, 24 to 56. Scottsdale Sprinters runs the Mini Bus (24 Pax) at 24, the Executive Mini Bus — Grech (27 Pax) at 27, the Executive Mini Coach (29 Pax) at 29 and the 56-Passenger Motorcoach at 56, with rates of $185–$325/hr.

How many people fit in a bus?

Between 24 and 56 on a Scottsdale Sprinters coach, against 28 on the Party Bus (28 Pax). Past 56 riders the answer is more than one vehicle: up to 3 of a repeatable unit, or 2 or more vehicles quoted as a large group.

What is the party bus size and capacity?

Scottsdale Sprinters lists one party bus, the Party Bus (28 Pax), at 28 seats and $250 per hour. Party-class capacity overall is 13 to 28 seats at $175–$295/hr; coaches cover 24 to 56 at $185–$325/hr.
